_note: Draft Duel tuning. Times are in seconds, distances in tiles. The fighting itself is tuned in battle_rules.json. Starters: up to `starters` animals worth up to `starter_budget` Acorns. Training an animal up a star costs its card cost times its current stars, plus train_extra; each star after the first adds star_bonus_pct to health and bite. Interest: at the end of each round every player earns 1 Acorn for each interest_per Acorns saved, up to interest_cap. Win streaks: winning win_streak_from rounds in a row pays win_streak_bonus[0] at the start of the next round, one more win pays the next value, and so on (the last value for any longer streak). A round's loser loses heart_loss_per_round hearts for each round played so far, plus heart_loss_per_animal for each of the winner's animals still standing; a player who folds loses only the first part.
